affected_row_semantics.ema_note: EMA-based features (Close_to_EMA_12/26, MACD_*) have exponentially decaying memory beyond 50 sessions; the residual influence of an unadjusted event older than 50 sessions is a recorded limitation, not an exclusion criterion
affected_row_semantics.event_session: E = the first trading session (of the stock's own calendar) whose price reflects the event, i.e. the discontinuity sits in the session-E return Close[E]/Close[E-1]-1
affected_row_semantics.excluded_rows: D in [E-h, E+49] (session indices), per horizon h
affected_row_semantics.lookback: row D's features span the event iff E lies in the last 50 sessions ending at D: D in [E, E+49] (session indices)
affected_row_semantics.target: row D's h-session target Close[D+h]/Close[D]-1 spans the event iff D < E <= D+h: D in [E-h, E-1]
affected_row_semantics.timing: session-based semantics of Phases 9-10: prediction timestamp D 16:30 America/New_York, gap = h

UTX.basis: legal/security continuation: United Technologies was the legal survivor of the Raytheon merger completed 2020-04-03 and was renamed Raytheon Technologies (ticker RTX, later RTX Corporation)
UTX.condition: Phase 11.1 must verify whether the provider's adjusted RTX history correctly accounts for the Carrier/Otis distributions and related corporate actions; if not, the general event-span exclusion rule applies; no other ticker is substituted

excluded.DD: the 2016 DJIA member DD (E.I. du Pont de Nemours) does not have a single continuous listed security series covering the full research interval; today's DD successor security is NOT substituted and NO synthetic shareholder-return series is constructed

intervals.confirmation_note: confirmation holdout, not pristine for AAPL; evaluated only for development qualifiers with explicit authorization; otherwise never read

adjustment_rule.abnormal_move: z(s) = (r_adj(s) - r_SPY(s)) / sample std (ddof=1) of the stock's excess returns over the 60 sessions before s; abnormal iff |z| > 4; r = Close[s]/Close[s-1] - 1 on adjusted closes
adjustment_rule.additional_provider_actions: every other provider split record is tested with the split rule
adjustment_rule.event_session: E = first session of the stock on or after the documented public date
adjustment_rule.exchange_offer (non-pro-rata): NO_ADJUSTMENT_REQUIRED (no distribution to all holders); z reported if a date is known
adjustment_rule.merger_continuity: CONTINUOUS iff every reference session in [E-60, E+60] is present (no adjustment needed for the survivor)
adjustment_rule.otherwise: NOT_PROPERLY_ADJUSTED -> frozen exclusion D in [E-h, E+49] (session indices) at E and at every record session; prices never repaired, no splicing, no substitution
adjustment_rule.provider_record: a Stock_Splits value not in {0, 1}, or a Dividends value > 3 x the median of the stock's positive dividends, within sessions [E-3, E+3]
adjustment_rule.spin_off / distribution: PROPERLY_ADJUSTED iff a provider record exists AND |z| <= 4 at E and at every record session
adjustment_rule.split / reverse split: PROPERLY_ADJUSTED iff a split record exists in the window AND |z| <= 4 at E and the record session

PHASE_11_1_IMPLEMENTATION.missing_session_rule: missing reference session m -> rows with reference index in [m-h, m+49] excluded (implementation of the frozen 'rows needing a missing session are excluded')
